name: Swiss Grotesque
description: Archivo for display and text, set heavy and tight; a Newsreader italic for the quote role; IBM Plex Mono for labels, captions, code, and numerals.

provenance.attribution: Archivo, Newsreader, and IBM Plex Mono, by their project authors, self-hosted from their pinned npm packages for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.

provenance.maintainer: The upstream projects, at the versions fonts.provenance.json pins
provenance.derivation: Role metrics by the platform for the swiss-signal and singular direction (packs-plan §3.2); font files copied unmodified from @fontsource-variable/archivo 5.3.0, @fontsource/newsreader 5.3.0, and IBM's split WOFF2 in @ibm/plex-mono 2.5.0, never subset or renamed inside.

fallbacks: Each shipped family is followed by metric-matched fallback faces over local system fonts (size-adjust and ascent, descent, and line-gap overrides), then a system stack and a generic family.
There's a fallback face at each weight the roles set, over the system bold for a heading, and Newsreader's italic falls back to the system italic.
Glyphs outside every shipped face's unicode-range render in the declared system stack, so text never goes missing.
caveats: The quote role ships Newsreader italic only, so quotes read italic whether or not a composition sets font-style, and its fallback is the system italic.
Labels, captions, code, and numerals share one IBM Plex Mono weight, 500, and Plex covers Latin-1 alone.
Archivo ships upright only: em in running text renders as a slanted Archivo, since its italic (39,156 B) would take the faces a Latin page loads past 102,400 B.
Archivo's latin-ext subset (32,608 B) loads only on a page whose text needs it, such as ő or ł; a Latin page loads 77,136 B. Other scripts render in the declared system stack.

label.font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace

caption.font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace
